user: I keep forgetting people's names, any tips?
raw: That's a common thing to happen, it happens to almost everyone. One really helpful tip is to make a conscious effort to really listen when someone is introducing themselves. Try to repeat their name back to them right after they say it. That's a simple technique that helps lock the name into your memory. Another thing you can do is try to associate the name with something you remember about that person, like a funny characteristic or something they mentioned during the conversation. The more details you can attach to the name, the stronger the memory becomes. Also, try to focus on the face and the tone of voice, because those are often the things that stick in our minds more than just the sound of the name itself. And remember, it's okay to say, "I'm so sorry, could you remind me of your name again?" It shows you care about remembering, and most people will be happy to help.
